correctness.rationale: From exact row/column constraints every admissible 3x3 zero-diagonal matrix is A_p. First event rate competition gives P(K>=2)=b/(1+b). Given two infectious individuals and one susceptible, exponential memorylessness yields the product of failure probabilities 1/[(1+bp)(1+b(1-p))]. The resulting P(K>=3) increases strictly in p(1-p), proving an entire stochastic-order frontier. Differentiation of b^3/[(1+b)^2(b+2)^2] has one positive zero (3+sqrt33)/2 and zero endpoints, establishing the unique global maximal value. The package CHECKER.py independently derives exact P(K=3) from full CTMC states and verifies identities symbolically.

originality.rationale: Primary full text of Ueki et al. (arxiv:2601.13730v2 §§2,3,S2), McCulloch et al. (2016, unweighted small graphs and triangle Table 2), Wilkinson et al. (2017 directed stochastic SIR method), and Hall–Siebert (2023 tree-exact bounds) inspected for same statement and dominating implications. The 2016 undirected triangle endpoint is explicitly prior-covered. Unlike these, the proposed result gives the entire 3-node directed-balanced class, sharp stochastic order at fixed reproduction spectral radius, and a global exact gap over infection rates. Semantic published-record searches returned scientifically different closest results, none covering the weighted triangle frontier. Unseen equivalent full-text results remain a risk.

An unindexed equivalent computation or general stochastic-order result for weighted three-node directed Markov SIR could subsume the result; finite searches do not prove uniqueness.
The natural three-person model is a sharp structural demonstration, not a large-population risk prediction.

value.rationale: Exactly three balanced zero-loop vertices form the smallest complete class in which directed edge-weight asymmetry can vary at fixed Perron reproduction threshold. An exhaustive exact final-size distribution and first-order stochastic ordering distinguish final outbreak vulnerability from threshold data, with sharp extremizers and a nonobvious universal gap maximal at a specific transmission/recovery ratio. This is an interpretable natural complete classification, not an arbitrarily selected invariant or just a recomputation of the known undirected endpoint.
